title: portal.json
description: The extra catalog the portal loads at runtime from /config/portal.json. Everything is optional: an empty object leaves the built-in generic catalog as it is.

lede.description: The sentence under the heading. Defaults to a generic one.

issuer.description: The sign-in URL shown in the footer, when the estate wants one.

replaceDefaults.description: Drop the built-in catalog (its orientation notes and anything else it carries) instead of adding to it. An estate with its own orientation sets this; the default is false.

tierOrder.description: Tier names in the order the page shows them. Tiers not listed follow, in the order their first entry appears.

entries.description: Things somebody can open. Grouped on the page by `tier`, in the order given.

orientation.description: Short notes shown first, under "Start here".

commandLine.description: Terminal recipes: a sentence and a command somebody can paste.

guides.description: Documentation links, grouped under a heading each.

url.description: An http(s) URL or a path on this host. Never a javascript: or data: URL.

name.description: A unique, stable name. A later entry with the same name replaces an earlier one, which is how an estate overrides a built-in.

host.description: The host it answers on, shown under the title.

tier.description: The heading it is listed under: a cluster, an environment, a team, anything.

tailnet.description: Shown with a badge: reachable only over the private network.

catalog.description: Shown with an `api` badge: a host that is served but is not a page somebody signs in to.

requires.description: The groups that are admitted, shown as "held by ...".
